review_notes: IMAGE-ONLY PAGE (limitation). Viewed previews/page-0019.png at full size and confirmed by eye what is printed, but the page CANNOT be faithfully transcribed: MuPDF returns 0 extractable characters for this page and the extractor already recorded 'OCR unavailable or failed: FzErrorLibrary'. There is therefore no reliable native text layer, and the page is a Nature Portfolio Reporting Summary form whose meaning depends on checkbox state (crossed vs empty boxes) that a text transcription would lose. Per the review plan I KEPT THE WHOLE PAGE AS A SINGLE IMAGE and preserved mode="image"; I did NOT hand-transcribe it and I make no searchable-text claim for this page. What I changed: bbox confirmed to be the exact full MediaBox [0, 0, 612, 792] pt (note this page is US Letter, 612x792 pt, unlike the 595.276x790.866 pt article pages), and the extractor placeholder asset name 'page-0019' / label 'PDF page 19' was replaced with 'reporting-summary-page-1' / 'Reporting Summary (page 1 of 3)' so the three form pages are identifiable in the asset directory instead of being named after PDF page order. Page 1 of 3 of the Reporting Summary. Visible content: corresponding authors (Alex Zhavoronkov, Alan Aspuru-Guzik, Igor Stagljar, Christoph Gorgulla, AkshatKumar Nigam), last updated Dec 2, 2024, and the Statistics, Software and code (Data collection: VirtualFlow 2.0 and Chemistry42; Data analysis: custom Python scripts) and Data sections, ending with the Zenodo repository URL https://zenodo.org/records/11137638.
